records.literal_gloss: [The] sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; three [were] born to him from Bath-shua the Canaanite. And was Er, [the] firstborn of Judah, evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and he put him to death.

en.L: [The] sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; [these] three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite [woman]. And Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put him to death.
en.B: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. Bath-shua, a Canaanite woman, was the mother of these three. But Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s eyes, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought his life to an end.
en.R: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan and Shelah. Their mother was Bath-shua, a Canaanite woman. Er, Judah's oldest son, did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saw as evil, so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} caused him to die.

es.R: Los hijos de Judá fueron Er, Onán y Selá. Su madre fue Bat-súa, una mujer cananea. Er, el hijo mayor de Judá, hacía lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} consideraba malo, y por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que muriera.

fr.R: Juda a eu pour fils Er, Onan et Shéla. Leur mère était Bath-Shoua, une Cananéenne. Er, le fils aîné de Juda, a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} considère comme mal, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a fait mourir.

decisions.reason: Genesis 38:2 and 38:12 call Judah's wife the daughter of Shua, a Canaanite. Here the same words serve as her name.

decisions.choice: Er was evil ... and he put him to death: Genesis 38:7
decisions.reason: The words follow Genesis 38:7 (see the decisions there, including the play between the name Er and the word for "evil"). Genesis repeats the LORD as subject of the second verb; Chronicles only says "he", but the LORD is meant. Onan's death (Genesis 38:10) is not mentioned.

decisions.choice: the LORD caused him to die
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as subject, as Genesis 38:7 does, instead of a pronoun.
The words "daughter of Shua" stand here as the woman's name (m1); Spanish joins them as a name, "Bat-súa", with the "Súa" of the published Genesis 38:2.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo morir" (L); "{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso fin a su vida" (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has a pronoun where Genesis 38:7 names the LORD; Spanish writes the pronoun "él" so the reader setting can capitalize it, and Readable names the LORD as the English does.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" (default), "Yahvé" (alternative) for the divine name, with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: For this block, as the Pentateuch and Samuel terms notes set: "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals, like the English "the LORD"; "l'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the form a reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: naye akamuua; naye akakomesha (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: Swahili carries "he" in the verb prefix, which cannot take a capital, so the English deity_pronoun span has no counterpart here; "naye" refers back to the LORD.

decisions.choice: wording of the Vietnamese Genesis 38:7, with "Ngài" where Chronicles says only "he"
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Genesis 38:7, so each level keeps that wording; Literal and Balanced follow the Hebrew's pronoun with the deity_pronoun span, and Readable names the LORD as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; "그분께서" (L) and the name (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the English "he/He" span has nothing to change; respect is carried by the honorific (그분께서, -시-), as the Korean style guide sets.

en.R: Carmi's son was Achar, who brought trouble on Israel. He was unfaithful by taking some of the devoted things, the things that belonged to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} alone.

es.R: El hijo de Carmi fue Acar, que trajo desgracia sobre Israel. Fue infiel al quedarse con cosas consagradas a la destrucción, cosas que pertenecían solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 갈미의 아들들은 아갈, 곧 바친 물건에 대하여 신의를 저버려 이스라엘을 괴롭게 한 자이다.
ko.B: 갈미의 아들은 아갈이었다. 그는 바친 물건에 대하여 신의를 저버려 이스라엘에 괴로움을 가져온 사람이다.
ko.R: 갈미의 아들은 아갈이었다. 그는 이스라엘에 괴로움을 가져왔다. 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 바친 물건을 가져가서 신의를 저버렸기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: Achar, the troubler: a play on his name
decisions.reason: Joshua 7 calls this man Achan. Here he is Achar, which sounds like the verb "to trouble" ('akhar) used of him in Joshua 7:25 ("Why have you troubled us?"), where the place of his death is named the Valley of Achor (7:26). The spelling ties his name to what he did.

decisions.choice: acted unfaithfully in the devoted thing: Joshua 7:1
decisions.reason: The words repeat Joshua 7:1, where Achan took goods from Jericho that were devoted to the LORD (see the decisions there). Joshua 7:1 calls Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah; Zabdi is probably Zimri of verse 6, a near form of the same name.

decisions.choice: son, not sons, before a single name
decisions.reason: The list heading is plural ("sons of") even when one name follows. Balanced and Readable use the singular there, which is how English says it; Literal keeps the plural.

decisions.choice: the things that belonged to the LORD alone
decisions.reason: Readable explains the devoted things as Joshua 7:1 does.

decisions.choice: "Acar, el que turbó a Israel" (L); "trajo desgracia sobre Israel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name Achar sounds like the verb "to trouble" (m1); Spanish cannot keep the play, so Literal uses "turbó" and Balanced and Readable "trajo desgracia". The devoted things are "lo consagrado a la destrucción", as the Samuel note sets for *ḥerem*.
With one name after the plural heading, Balanced and Readable use the singular, as the English does.

decisions.choice: l'interdit; les choses vouées à l'interdit
decisions.reason: French has a set word for *ḥerem*, "l'interdit", for things given over to God by destruction; Readable explains it as the English Readable does.
The heading "sons of" stands even before a single name; Balanced and Readable say "mwana" there, Literal keeps "wana", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Con trai" (singular) before one name at B and R
decisions.reason: The heading "sons of" is plural even before a single name; Balanced and Readable use the singular, as the English does, and Literal keeps "các con trai". The same is done through chapters 2-9.
"Devoted thing" is said as what was given to God ("바친 물건"), and the verb of unfaithfulness as breaking faith ("신의를 저버리다"); Readable explains whose the things were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Chelubai: another form of the name Caleb
decisions.reason: Chelubai is the Caleb son of Hezron of verses 18 and 42. He is not Caleb son of Jephunneh, the spy of Numbers 13:6, who lived several generations later (see verses 18 and 49).
The three sons are followed in turn: Ram's line to David (verses 10-17), Caleb's family (18-24), Jerahmeel's (25-41), and more of Caleb's (42-55).

decisions.choice: Ram to David: the line of Ruth 4:19-22
decisions.reason: Verses 10-15 give the same line as Ruth 4:19-22. Nahshon was the leader of Judah in the wilderness (Numbers 1:7; 2:3; 7:12).

decisions.choice: begot: became the father or ancestor of
decisions.reason: This verb is the formula of the family lists. It can name a grandfather or later ancestor as well as a father, so a list may skip generations.

decisions.choice: begot (Literal), was the father of (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: One wording for this formula at each level throughout the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 1-9; Ruth 4 has "fathered" for the same verb.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Giu-đa" (L); "người Giu-đa" (B); "chi tộc Giu-đa" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span here; the Vietnamese words already include women and men, so there is only one wording. The same holds through chapters 2-9.

decisions.choice: "유다 자손" (L), "유다 백성" (B) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "자손" and "백성" take in the whole people, so Korean has one wording where the English has a gender span. Amminadab, Nahshon and the line to David keep the names of the Korean Matthew 1 (아미나답, 나손, 보아스, 오벳, 이새), with Chronicles' own Salma (살마).

decisions.choice: Abishai, Joab and Asahel: David's nephews
decisions.reason: Zeruiah's three sons were David's warriors and Joab his commander (2 Samuel 2:18; 8:16). They are always named by their mother; their father is never named (2 Samuel 2:32 mentions his tomb in Bethlehem). The name Abishai is written here in a shorter form (Abshai).

decisions.choice: their sisters: David's sisters or half-sisters
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 17:25 calls Abigail the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah. They may have been half-sisters of Jesse's sons; see the decisions there.
Readable says whose sisters they were.

As in the Korean 2 Samuel 17:25, Amasa's mother is "아비갈", kept apart from Nabal's wife "아비가일".

decisions.choice: Jether the Ishmaelite: "Ithra the Israelite" in 2 Samuel 17:25
decisions.reason: Jether and Ithra are two forms of one name. 2 Samuel 17:25 calls him "the Israelite"; Chronicles says "the Ishmaelite", which would explain why his people are mentioned at all (see the decision at 2 Samuel 17:25). The Hebrew of Chronicles is followed here.
Amasa led Absalom's army against David (2 Samuel 17:25), later became David's commander, and was killed by his cousin Joab (2 Samuel 20:10).

decisions.choice: "Giê-the", the form of the name Chronicles uses
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 17:25 has the other form of the name, "Gít-ra"; the Vietnamese follows each book's spelling, as the English does.

decisions.choice: fathered children by Azubah and by Jerioth
alternatives: Caleb fathered Jerioth by his wife Azubah
decisions.reason: Word for word the Hebrew says Caleb "fathered Azubah, a wife, and Jerioth", but this verb normally takes the child as its object. It is read here as fathering children by the two women. Others take Jerioth as a daughter of Caleb and Azubah, or as Azubah's other name. "Her sons" most likely means Azubah's, who is named again in verse 19.

decisions.choice: Caleb son of Hezron: one of several Calebs
decisions.reason: This Caleb (Chelubai in verse 9) is Judah's great-grandson. Caleb son of Jephunneh, the spy who took Hebron (Numbers 13:6; Joshua 14:13-14), lived in Moses' time. The family of this earlier Caleb holds towns linked with the later one (Hebron in verse 42, Achsah in verse 49), and verse 42 speaks of Caleb "the brother of Jerahmeel"; the lists do not say how the Calebs are related.
English needs the word "children" for the sense in m1.
The verb normally takes the child as object (m1); Spanish, like the English, needs the word "hijos" to say that Caleb had children by these women.
French "ses" does not show whether the sons are hers or Caleb's; Balanced and Readable name the mother, the reading of the meaning decision (m1).

ko.R: 아수바가 죽은 뒤에 갈렙은 에브랏과 결혼했다. 그들 사이에서 훌이라는 아들이 태어났다.

decisions.reason: "Took" a woman for oneself means took her as wife.
Ephrath, also Ephrathah (verses 24 and 50), is a name tied to Bethlehem (Genesis 35:19; Ruth 4:11; Micah 5:1). Her son Hur is the ancestor of the founder of Bethlehem (verses 50-51).

ko.R: 훌은 우리를 낳고, 우리는 브살렐을 낳았다.

decisions.reason: Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, was the man the LORD chose to make the tabernacle and its furnishings (Exodus 31:2; 35:30).

es.R: Más tarde, cuando Hezrón tenía sesenta años, se casó con la hija de Maquir, el padre de Galaad. Ella tuvo con él un hijo llamado Segub.

fr.L: Et ensuite Hesron entra vers la fille de Makir, père de Galaad, et il la prit alors qu’il [était] âgé de soixante ans ; et elle lui enfanta Segoub.
fr.B: Plus tard, Hesron s’unit à la fille de Makir, père de Galaad ; il l’avait épousée à l’âge de soixante ans. Elle lui donna Segoub.
fr.R: Plus tard, quand Hesron avait soixante ans, il s’est marié avec la fille de Makir, le père de Galaad. Elle a eu de lui un fils, Segoub.

sw.L: Na baadaye Hesroni aliingia kwa binti Makiri baba wa Gileadi, naye akamtwaa alipokuwa [mwana wa] miaka sitini; naye akamzalia Segubu.
sw.B: Baadaye Hesroni alilala na binti Makiri baba wa Gileadi, aliyemwoa akiwa na umri wa miaka sitini. Naye akamzalia Segubu.
sw.R: Baadaye, Hesroni alipokuwa na umri wa miaka sitini, alimwoa binti Makiri, baba wa Gileadi. Akapata naye mwana aitwaye Segubu.

vi.L: Và sau đó Hết-rôn đi đến với con gái của Ma-ki cha của Ga-la-át, và ông lấy nàng khi ông [được] sáu mươi tuổi; và nàng sinh cho ông Sê-gúp.
vi.B: Về sau Hết-rôn ăn ở với con gái của Ma-ki, cha của Ga-la-át; ông cưới nàng làm vợ khi được sáu mươi tuổi. Nàng sinh cho ông Sê-gúp.
vi.R: Về sau, khi Hết-rôn được sáu mươi tuổi, ông cưới con gái của Ma-ki, cha của Ga-la-át. Bà sinh cho ông một con trai tên là Sê-gúp.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 헤스론이 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 딸에게 들어갔다. 그가 60세였을 때 그녀를 맞아들였고, 그녀가 그에게 스굽을 낳아 주었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 헤스론은 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 딸과 동침했는데, 60세에 그녀를 아내로 맞아들였다. 그녀는 그에게 스굽을 낳아 주었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 헤스론은 60세 때에 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 딸과 결혼했다. 그녀는 헤스론에게서 스굽이라는 아들을 낳았다.

decisions.choice: went in to ... took her: married and lived with her
decisions.reason: "Went in to" a woman speaks of sexual union; "took her" shows that it was in marriage.

decisions.choice: Machir the father of Gilead: Manasseh's family
decisions.reason: Machir was the son of Manasseh and the ancestor of the people of Gilead, east of the Jordan (Numbers 26:29; 32:39-40). Through this marriage a family of Judah was joined to Manasseh.
Readable puts the age first so the order of events is plain.
Ages are written in figures, as in the Korean 1 and 2 Kings.

source.text: וּשְׂג֖וּב הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יָאִ֑יר וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And Segub begot Jair, and belonged to him twenty-three cities in [the] land of the Gilead.

en.L: And Segub begot Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
en.B: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
en.R: Segub was the father of Jair. Jair had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

es.L: Y Segub engendró a Jaír, y él tuvo veintitrés ciudades en la tierra de Galaad.
es.B: Segub fue padre de Jaír, que tuvo veintitrés pueblos en la tierra de Galaad.
es.R: Segub fue padre de Jaír. Jaír tuvo veintitrés pueblos en la tierra de Galaad.

fr.L: Et Segoub engendra Yaïr, et il eut vingt-trois villes dans le pays de Galaad.
fr.B: Segoub fut le père de Yaïr, qui eut vingt-trois villes dans le pays de Galaad.
fr.R: Segoub a eu pour fils Yaïr. Yaïr a eu vingt-trois villes dans le pays de Galaad.

sw.L: Na Segubu alimzaa Yairi, naye alikuwa na miji ishirini na mitatu katika nchi ya Gileadi.
sw.B: Segubu alikuwa baba wa Yairi, aliyekuwa na miji ishirini na mitatu katika nchi ya Gileadi.
sw.R: Segubu alikuwa baba wa Yairi. Yairi alikuwa na miji ishirini na mitatu katika nchi ya Gileadi.

vi.L: Và Sê-gúp sinh Giai-rơ, và ông có hai mươi ba thành trong xứ Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Sê-gúp là cha của Giai-rơ, người có hai mươi ba thị trấn trong xứ Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Sê-gúp là cha của Giai-rơ. Giai-rơ có hai mươi ba thị trấn trong xứ Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 스굽은 야일을 낳았다. 그리고 그에게 길르앗 땅에 스물세 성읍이 있었다.
ko.B: 스굽은 야일을 낳았는데, 야일은 길르앗 땅에 스물세 성읍을 가지고 있었다.
ko.R: 스굽은 야일을 낳았다. 야일은 길르앗 땅에 마을 스물세 개를 가지고 있었다.

decisions.choice: Jair: called a son of Manasseh in Numbers
decisions.reason: Numbers 32:41 and Deuteronomy 3:14 call Jair a son of Manasseh, who took villages in Gilead and named them after himself. Chronicles shows that his grandmother was of Manasseh's family and his father's line was Judah.
The word covers settlements of any size; "towns" suits places in a country district.
The word covers settlements of any size; Balanced and Readable say "pueblos", as the English says "towns". Jaír and Havot-jaír keep the forms of the published Deuteronomy 3:14.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר־וַ֠אֲרָם אֶת־חַוֺּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵאִתָּ֛ם אֶת־קְנָ֥ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כָּל־אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִי־גִלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Geshur and Aram the villages of Jair from them, Kenath and its daughters, sixty cities. All these [were the] sons of Machir, father of Gilead.

en.L: And Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, Kenath and its daughters, sixty cities. All these [were the] sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
en.B: But Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, with Kenath and its villages, sixty towns. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
en.R: But the kingdoms of Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, together with Kenath and the villages around it, sixty towns in all. All these people were descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.

es.L: Y Gesur y Aram les tomaron las aldeas de Jaír, Kenat y sus hijas, sesenta ciudades. Todos estos [fueron los] hijos de Maquir, padre de Galaad.
es.B: Pero Gesur y Aram les quitaron Havot-jaír, junto con Kenat y sus aldeas, sesenta pueblos. Todos estos fueron descendientes de Maquir, padre de Galaad.
es.R: Pero los reinos de Gesur y Aram les quitaron las aldeas de Jaír, junto con Kenat y las aldeas de alrededor, sesenta pueblos en total. Todos ellos eran descendientes de Maquir, el padre de Galaad.

fr.L: Et Gueshour et Aram leur prirent les villages de Yaïr, Qenath et ses filles, soixante villes. Tous ceux-là [étaient] les fils de Makir, père de Galaad.
fr.B: Mais Gueshour et Aram leur prirent Havvoth-Yaïr, avec Qenath et ses villages, soixante villes. Tous ceux-là étaient des descendants de Makir, père de Galaad.
fr.R: Mais les royaumes de Gueshour et d’Aram leur ont pris les villages de Yaïr, avec Qenath et les villages autour, soixante villes en tout. Tous ces gens étaient des descendants de Makir, le père de Galaad.

sw.L: Na Geshuri na Aramu wakatwaa vijiji vya Yairi kutoka kwao, Kenathi na binti zake, miji sitini. Hawa wote [walikuwa] wana wa Makiri baba wa Gileadi.
sw.B: Lakini Geshuri na Aramu waliwanyang'anya Havoth-yairi, pamoja na Kenathi na vijiji vyake, miji sitini. Hao wote walikuwa wazao wa Makiri baba wa Gileadi.
sw.R: Lakini falme za Geshuri na Aramu ziliwanyang'anya vijiji vya Yairi, pamoja na Kenathi na vijiji vilivyouzunguka, miji sitini kwa jumla. Watu hao wote walikuwa wazao wa Makiri, baba wa Gileadi.

vi.L: Và Ghê-su-rơ và A-ram lấy các làng của Giai-rơ khỏi họ, Kê-nát và các con gái của nó, sáu mươi thành. Tất cả những người này [là] các con trai của Ma-ki cha của Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Nhưng Ghê-su-rơ và A-ram chiếm lấy Ha-vốt Giai-rơ của họ, cùng với Kê-nát và các làng chung quanh, tổng cộng sáu mươi thị trấn. Tất cả những người này là con cháu của Ma-ki, cha của Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Nhưng các vương quốc Ghê-su-rơ và A-ram chiếm lấy các làng của Giai-rơ, cùng với Kê-nát và các làng chung quanh, tổng cộng sáu mươi thị trấn. Tất cả những người này là con cháu của Ma-ki, cha của Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 그술과 아람이 그들에게서 야일의 마을들, 곧 그낫과 그 딸들, 예순 성읍을 빼앗았다. 이들이 모두 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그술과 아람이 그들에게서 하봇야일과 그낫과 그 주변 마을들, 곧 예순 성읍을 빼앗았다. 이들은 모두 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 자손이었다.
ko.R: 그러나 그술 왕국과 아람 왕국이 그들에게서 야일의 마을들과 그낫과 그 둘레의 마을들, 모두 예순 성읍을 빼앗았다. 이 사람들은 모두 길르앗의 아버지 마길의 자손이었다.

decisions.choice: Geshur and Aram: kingdoms to the north
decisions.reason: Geshur and Aram were Aramean kingdoms north and east of Gilead (2 Samuel 3:3; 15:8). The list does not say when they took these towns.

decisions.choice: its daughters: the villages that belonged to a town
decisions.reason: A town's "daughters" are the smaller settlements around it.
"All these" are the people of verses 21-23, Machir's descendants through his daughter.
Balanced uses the place name, "villages of Jair", as Numbers 32:41 does.
Literal keeps the Hebrew "its daughters" for the villages belonging to a town; Balanced and Readable say "vijiji vyake".

decisions.choice: "các con gái của nó" kept at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of a town's "daughters" for its villages, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "các làng chung quanh".
Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom of a town's "daughters"; Balanced and Readable say "주변 마을들", as the English does.

source.text: וְאַחַ֥ר מוֹת־חֶצְר֖וֹן בְּכָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְאֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֽוֹעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And after [the] death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, and [the] wife of Hezron [was] Abijah, and she bore to him Ashhur, father of Tekoa.

en.L: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, the wife of Hezron [was] Abijah, and she bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
en.B: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
en.R: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah gave birth to his son Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.

es.L: Y después de la muerte de Hezrón en Caleb-efrata, la mujer de Hezrón [fue] Abías, y ella le dio a luz a Asur, padre de Tecoa.
es.B: Después de que Hezrón murió en Caleb-efrata, su mujer Abías le dio a luz a Asur, padre de Tecoa.
es.R: Después de que Hezrón murió en Caleb-efrata, su esposa Abías dio a luz a su hijo Asur, el fundador de Tecoa.

fr.L: Et après la mort d’Hesron à Caleb-Éphrata, la femme d’Hesron [était] Abiya, et elle lui enfanta Ashhour, père de Teqoa.
fr.B: Après la mort d’Hesron à Caleb-Éphrata, Abiya, sa femme, lui donna Ashhour, père de Teqoa.
fr.R: Après la mort d’Hesron à Caleb-Éphrata, sa femme Abiya a mis au monde son fils Ashhour, le fondateur de Teqoa.

sw.L: Na baada ya kifo cha Hesroni huko Kalebu-efrata, mke wa Hesroni [alikuwa] Abiya, naye akamzalia Ashhuri baba wa Tekoa.
sw.B: Hesroni alipokwisha kufa huko Kalebu-efrata, mke wake Abiya alimzalia Ashhuri baba wa Tekoa.
sw.R: Baada ya Hesroni kufa huko Kalebu-efrata, mke wake Abiya alimzalia mwana, Ashhuri, mwanzilishi wa Tekoa.

vi.L: Và sau khi Hết-rôn qua đời tại Ca-lép Ép-ra-ta, vợ của Hết-rôn [là] A-bi-gia, và bà sinh cho ông Át-hu-rơ cha của Thê-cô-a.
vi.B: Sau khi Hết-rôn qua đời tại Ca-lép Ép-ra-ta, A-bi-gia vợ ông sinh cho ông Át-hu-rơ, cha của Thê-cô-a.
vi.R: Sau khi Hết-rôn qua đời tại Ca-lép Ép-ra-ta, A-bi-gia vợ ông sinh cho ông một con trai là Át-hu-rơ, người lập ra thành Thê-cô-a.

ko.L: 그리고 헤스론이 갈렙 에브라다에서 죽은 뒤에, 헤스론의 아내는 아비야였는데, 그녀가 그에게 드고아의 아버지 아스훌을 낳아 주었다.
ko.B: 헤스론이 갈렙 에브라다에서 죽은 뒤에, 헤스론의 아내 아비야가 그에게 드고아의 아버지 아스훌을 낳아 주었다.
ko.R: 헤스론이 갈렙 에브라다에서 죽은 뒤에, 그의 아내 아비야가 헤스론의 아들 아스훌을 낳았다. 아스훌은 드고아를 세운 사람이다.

decisions.choice: after Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore him Ashhur
alternatives: after Hezron died, Caleb went in to Ephrathah, the wife of Hezron his father, and she bore him Ashhur
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is unusual: a place named Caleb-ephrathah appears nowhere else, and the son is born after his father's death. The early Greek translation reads "after Hezron died, Caleb went in to Ephrathah", and some take Abijah to be a word for "his father", so that Caleb took his father's widow. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: father of a town: its founder, or the head of the clan that settled it
decisions.reason: When a man is called "father of" a town (here Tekoa, south of Bethlehem: 2 Samuel 14:2; Amos 1:1), he is its founder or the ancestor and head of the clan that lived there. The same title comes back many times in chapters 2, 4, 8 and 9. In a few places it is not certain whether the name after "father of" is a town or a person who bore a town's name.
Readable explains "father of" a town (m2) with one word, here and wherever the title recurs in chapters 2-9. Literal and Balanced keep "father of", which leaves room for the other reading.
Readable explains "father of" a town (m2) with one word, here and wherever the title recurs in chapters 2-9; Literal and Balanced keep "padre de".
As the English Readable: "father" of a town is its founder or the head of the clan that settled it (m2). Literal and Balanced keep "père de"; Readable says "fondateur" throughout these chapters.
"Baba wa" a town (Literal, Balanced) is its founder or the head of the clan that settled it; Readable says "mwanzilishi wa" here and wherever the title recurs in chapters 2-9.

decisions.choice: "người lập ra (thành) X" at Readable for "father of" a town
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title "father of" a town in plain words, here and wherever it recurs in chapters 2-9; Literal and Balanced keep "cha của", which leaves room for the other reading.

decisions.choice: "father of" a town: "...를 세운 사람" at Readable
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "아버지"; Readable says the founder of the town, as the English does, through these lists.

source.text: וַיִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי־יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכ֥וֹר חֶצְר֖וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀רָ֑ם וּבוּנָ֥ה וָאֹ֛רֶן וָאֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And were [the] sons of Jerahmeel, [the] firstborn of Hezron: the firstborn Ram, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem, Ahijah.

en.L: And [the] sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were: the firstborn Ram, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem, Ahijah.
en.B: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram the firstborn, then Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.
en.R: Jerahmeel was Hezron's oldest son. His sons were Ram, the oldest, then Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Jerameel, el primogénito de Hezrón, fueron: el primogénito Ram, y Buna y Orén y Ozem, Ahías.
es.B: Los hijos de Jerameel, el primogénito de Hezrón: Ram, el primogénito, y después Buna, Orén, Ozem y Ahías.
es.R: Jerameel era el hijo mayor de Hezrón. Sus hijos fueron Ram, el mayor, y después Buna, Orén, Ozem y Ahías.

fr.L: Et les fils de Yerahmeel, premier-né d’Hesron, furent : le premier-né Ram, et Bouna et Orèn et Otsem, Ahiya.
fr.B: Les fils de Yerahmeel, premier-né d’Hesron : Ram, le premier-né, puis Bouna, Orèn, Otsem et Ahiya.
fr.R: Yerahmeel était le fils aîné d’Hesron. Il a eu pour fils Ram, l’aîné, puis Bouna, Orèn, Otsem et Ahiya.

sw.L: Na wana wa Yerameeli mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Hesroni walikuwa: mzaliwa wa kwanza Ramu, na Buna na Oreni na Osemu, Ahiya.
sw.B: Wana wa Yerameeli mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Hesroni: Ramu mzaliwa wa kwanza, kisha Buna, Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.
sw.R: Yerameeli alikuwa mwana mkubwa wa Hesroni. Wana wake walikuwa Ramu, mkubwa wao, kisha Buna, Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Giê-rác-mê-ên con đầu lòng của Hết-rôn là: con đầu lòng Ram, và Bu-na, Ô-ren, Ô-xem, A-hi-gia.
vi.B: Các con trai của Giê-rác-mê-ên, con đầu lòng của Hết-rôn, là Ram con đầu lòng, rồi Bu-na, Ô-ren, Ô-xem và A-hi-gia.
vi.R: Giê-rác-mê-ên là con trai cả của Hết-rôn. Các con trai của ông là Ram, con trai cả, rồi Bu-na, Ô-ren, Ô-xem và A-hi-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 헤스론의 맏아들 여라므엘의 아들들은 맏아들 람과 브나와 오렌과 오셈, 아히야였다.
ko.B: 헤스론의 맏아들 여라므엘의 아들들은 맏아들 람, 그다음 브나와 오렌과 오셈과 아히야였다.
ko.R: 여라므엘은 헤스론의 맏아들이었다. 그의 아들들은 맏아들 람, 그다음 브나, 오렌, 오셈, 아히야였다.

decisions.reason: There is no "and" before Ahijah, so some read "by Ahijah", the name of Jerahmeel's first wife, which would fit "another wife" in verse 26. As the text stands Ahijah is listed among the sons.
He is the nephew of Ram the ancestor of David (verses 9-10). Names often recur within a family.

source.text: וַתְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּשְׁמָ֣הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אוֹנָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And was a wife another to Jerahmeel, and her name [was] Atarah; she [was the] mother of Onam.

en.L: And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name [was] Atarah; she [was the] mother of Onam.
en.B: Jerahmeel had another wife, named Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

decisions.reason: Jarha belonged to Sheshan as a member of his household; he was not a hired worker.
As the style of this translation sets out for this word, Literal says "slave" and Balanced and Readable "servant" (m1).

decisions.reason: The words are hard to fit: one expects a second son of Caleb, not "the sons of" someone. The early Greek translation reads differently here, and something may have dropped out of the Hebrew. The Hebrew text is followed.

Caleb here is Caleb son of Hezron (verses 9, 18). Ziph, Mareshah and Hebron are towns of Judah (Joshua 15:44, 54-55). Hebron was given to Caleb son of Jephunneh (Joshua 14:13-14), so the lists join the families of the two Calebs (see verse 18).

decisions.choice: Achsah: the name of the daughter of Caleb son of Jephunneh
decisions.reason: Caleb son of Jephunneh gave his daughter Achsah to Othniel (Joshua 15:16-17; Judges 1:12-13). The list here gives a daughter of the same name to the earlier Caleb's family. Whether it treats the two Calebs as one family, it does not say (see verse 18).

decisions.choice: Madmannah, Machbenah, Gibea: towns of Judah
decisions.reason: Madmannah is in the south of Judah (Joshua 15:31); Gibea may be Gibeah of the hill country (Joshua 15:57).
As in verse 24: Readable explains "father of" a town.

en.R: These were Caleb's descendants. Hur was the oldest son of Ephrathah. His sons were Shobal, the founder of Kiriath-jearim,

vi.B: Đó là con cháu của Ca-lép. Các con trai của Hu-rơ, con đầu lòng của Ép-ra-ta, là Sô-banh, cha của Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim,

ko.L: 이들이 갈렙의 아들들이었다. 에브라다의 맏아들 훌의 아들은 기럇여아림의 아버지 소발,
ko.B: 이들이 갈렙의 자손이었다. 에브라다의 맏아들 훌의 아들들은 기럇여아림의 아버지 소발과,
ko.R: 이들이 갈렙의 자손이었다. 훌은 에브라다의 맏아들이었다. 그의 아들들은 기럇여아림을 세운 소발과,

decisions.choice: These were the sons of Caleb. The son of Hur ...
alternatives: These were the sons of Caleb son of Hur
decisions.reason: Word for word the Hebrew can be read "the sons of Caleb son of Hur". But Hur is Caleb's son (verse 19), and Ephrath(ah) is Hur's mother, so the sentence is read as closing Caleb's list, with "son of Hur" opening a new one. The early Greek translation reads it the same way.
Balanced and Readable say "descendants" in the closing line, as in verse 33, and "sons" for Hur's, since three are named (verses 50-51).

sw.R: Salma, mwanzilishi wa Bethlehemu, na Harefu, mwanzilishi wa Beth-gaderi.

vi.B: Sanh-ma, cha của Bết-lê-hem, và Ha-rép, cha của Bết-Ga-đe.
vi.R: Sanh-ma, người lập ra thành Bết-lê-hem, và Ha-rép, người lập ra thành Bết-Ga-đe.

ko.L: 베들레헴의 아버지 살마, 벧가델의 아버지 하렙이다.
ko.B: 베들레헴의 아버지 살마와, 벧가델의 아버지 하렙이었다.
ko.R: 베들레헴을 세운 살마와, 벧가델을 세운 하렙이었다.

decisions.reason: Bethlehem was the town of Ephrathah (Ruth 4:11; Micah 5:1), and David's family came from it. Salma is also the name of Boaz's father (verse 11); whether the two are one man is not said.
As in verse 24: Readable explains "father of" a town.

records.literal_gloss: And were sons to Shobal, father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

en.L: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.
en.B: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had descendants: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.
en.R: Shobal, the founder of Kiriath-jearim, had descendants: Haroeh and half of the Manahathites.

es.L: Y Sobal, padre de Quiriat-jearim, tuvo hijos: Haroe, la mitad de los manahatitas.
es.B: Sobal, padre de Quiriat-jearim, tuvo descendientes: Haroe, la mitad de los manahatitas.
es.R: Sobal, el fundador de Quiriat-jearim, tuvo descendientes: Haroe y la mitad de los manahatitas.

fr.L: Et Shobal, père de Qiryath-Yearim, eut des fils : Haroé, la moitié des Manahathites.
fr.B: Shobal, père de Qiryath-Yearim, eut des descendants : Haroé, la moitié des Manahathites.
fr.R: Shobal, le fondateur de Qiryath-Yearim, a eu des descendants : Haroé et la moitié des Manahathites.

vi.B: Sô-banh, cha của Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim, có con cháu là Ha-rô-ê và phân nửa người Ma-na-hát.
vi.R: Sô-banh, người lập ra thành Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim, có con cháu là Ha-rô-ê và một nửa dân Ma-na-hát.

ko.L: 그리고 기럇여아림의 아버지 소발에게 아들들이 있었으니, 하로에, 곧 마나핫 사람들의 절반이다.
ko.B: 기럇여아림의 아버지 소발에게는 자손이 있었는데, 하로에, 곧 마나핫 사람들의 절반이었다.
ko.R: 기럇여아림을 세운 소발에게는 자손이 있었는데, 하로에와 마나핫 사람들의 절반이었다.

alternatives: Haroeh, head of half the Manahathites
decisions.reason: Haroeh ("the seer") is probably Reaiah son of Shobal (4:2). The Manahathites (here spelled Menuhoth) seem to be a clan, half of which traced its descent from Shobal and half from Salma (verse 54). The words may also mean that Haroeh was the head of that half.
"Sons" here covers a person and a clan, so Balanced and Readable say "descendants".
As in verse 24: Readable explains "father of" a town.

source.text: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַיִּתְרִי֙ וְהַפּוּתִ֔י וְהַשֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵאֵ֗לֶּה יָצְאוּ֙ הַצָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְהָאֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [the] clans of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from these went out the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

en.L: And [the] clans of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from these went out the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
en.B: The clans of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites and the Mishraites. From these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
en.R: The clans of Kiriath-jearim were the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. The people of Zorah and Eshtaol came from these clans.

es.L: Y [los] clanes de Quiriat-jearim: los itritas y los futeos y los sumatitas y los misraítas; de estos salieron los zoratitas y los estaolitas.
es.B: Los clanes de Quiriat-jearim: los itritas, los futeos, los sumatitas y los misraítas. De ellos vinieron los zoratitas y los estaolitas.
es.R: Los clanes de Quiriat-jearim fueron los itritas, los futeos, los sumatitas y los misraítas. De estos clanes vino la gente de Zora y de Estaol.

fr.L: Et les clans de Qiryath-Yearim : les Yitrites et les Poutites et les Shoumatites et les Mishraïtes ; de ceux-ci sortirent les Tsoreatites et les Eshtaolites.
fr.B: Les clans de Qiryath-Yearim : les Yitrites, les Poutites, les Shoumatites et les Mishraïtes. De ceux-ci sont issus les Tsoreatites et les Eshtaolites.
fr.R: Les clans de Qiryath-Yearim ont été les Yitrites, les Poutites, les Shoumatites et les Mishraïtes. Les gens de Tsorea et d’Eshtaol sont venus de ces clans.

sw.L: Na koo za Kiriath-yearimu: Waithri na Waputhi na Washumathi na Wamishrai; kutoka kwa hawa walitoka Wasorathi na Waeshtaoli.
sw.B: Koo za Kiriath-yearimu: Waithri, Waputhi, Washumathi na Wamishrai. Kutoka kwa hao walitoka Wasorathi na Waeshtaoli.
sw.R: Koo za Kiriath-yearimu zilikuwa Waithri, Waputhi, Washumathi na Wamishrai. Watu wa Sora na wa Eshtaoli walitoka katika koo hizo.

vi.L: Và các họ hàng của Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim: người Dít-rít, người Phu-tít, người Su-ma-tít và người Mích-ra-ít; từ những người này ra người Xô-ra-tít và người Ếch-ta-ô-lít.

vi.R: Các gia tộc của Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim là người Dít-rít, người Phu-tít, người Su-ma-tít và người Mích-ra-ít. Dân thành Xô-ra và Ếch-ta-ôn ra từ các gia tộc ấy.

ko.R: 기럇여아림의 씨족들은 이델 사람, 붓 사람, 수맛 사람, 미스라 사람이었다. 소라와 에스다올에 사는 사람들이 이 씨족들에게서 나왔다.

decisions.choice: Zorathites and Eshtaolites: the people of Zorah and Eshtaol
decisions.reason: Zorah and Eshtaol are towns in the lowland west of Kiriath-jearim (Joshua 15:33), the home country of Samson (Judges 13:2, 25). Two of David's warriors were Ithrites (2 Samuel 23:38).

decisions.choice: the people of Zorah and Eshtaol
decisions.reason: Readable names the towns behind the clan names.
The words the Vietnamese Genesis uses for clans, kept through the genealogies.

ko.R: 살마의 자손은 베들레헴 사람들과 느도바 사람과 아다롯벳요압과 마나핫 사람들의 절반과 소리 사람이었다.

As in verse 52.

en.L: And the clans of [the] scribes who dwelt [at] Jabez: [the] Tirathites, [the] Shimeathites, [the] Sucathites. These [are] the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

en.R: Some families of scribes lived at Jabez. They were the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These were the Kenites who came from Hammath, the ancestor of the family of Rechab.

es.R: Algunas familias de escribas vivían en Jabes. Eran los tirateos, los simeateos y los sucateos. Estos eran los ceneos que vinieron de Hamat, el antepasado de la familia de Recab.

fr.L: Et les clans des scribes qui habitaient [à] Yabets : les Tireatites, les Shiméatites, les Soukatites. Ce [sont] les Kéniens qui vinrent de Hammath, père de la maison de Rékab.

fr.R: Des familles de scribes habitaient à Yabets. C’étaient les Tireatites, les Shiméatites et les Soukatites. C’étaient les Kéniens qui venaient de Hammath, l’ancêtre de la famille de Rékab.

sw.L: Na koo za waandishi waliokaa [huko] Yabesi: Watirathi, Washimeathi, Wasukathi. Hao [ndio] Wakeni waliotoka kwa Hamathi, baba wa nyumba ya Rekabu.
sw.B: Koo za waandishi walioishi Yabesi: Watirathi, Washimeathi na Wasukathi. Hao ndio Wakeni waliotoka kwa Hamathi, baba wa nyumba ya Rekabu.
sw.R: Baadhi ya jamaa za waandishi waliishi Yabesi. Hao walikuwa Watirathi, Washimeathi na Wasukathi. Hao ndio Wakeni waliotoka kwa Hamathi, babu wa jamaa ya Rekabu.

vi.L: Và các họ hàng của các thầy thông giáo ở [tại] Gia-bê: người Ti-ra-tít, người Si-mê-a-tít, người Su-ca-tít. Đó [là] người Kê-nít ra từ Ham-mát, cha của nhà Rê-cáp.
vi.B: Các gia tộc thầy thông giáo ở tại Gia-bê là người Ti-ra-tít, người Si-mê-a-tít và người Su-ca-tít. Đó là người Kê-nít ra từ Ham-mát, cha của nhà Rê-cáp.
vi.R: Có một số gia tộc thầy thông giáo sống tại Gia-bê. Họ là người Ti-ra-tít, người Si-mê-a-tít và người Su-ca-tít. Đó là người Kê-nít ra từ Ham-mát, tổ tiên của gia tộc Rê-cáp.

ko.L: 그리고 야베스에 사는 서기관들의 씨족들은 디랏 사람, 시므앗 사람, 수갓 사람이다. 이들은 레갑 집안의 아버지 함맛에게서 나온 겐 사람들이다.
ko.B: 야베스에 사는 서기관들의 씨족들은 디랏 사람과 시므앗 사람과 수갓 사람이었다. 이들은 레갑 집안의 아버지 함맛에게서 나온 겐 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 서기관 집안 몇이 야베스에 살았다. 그들은 디랏 사람, 시므앗 사람, 수갓 사람이었다. 이들은 함맛에게서 나온 겐 사람들인데, 함맛은 레갑 집안의 조상이다.

decisions.choice: who lived: written and read forms
decisions.reason: The written text has "they lived"; the form read aloud is "those living". The sense is the same.

The word means scribes, people skilled in writing, but here it may be the name of a clan (Sophrites). Jabez is a place not named elsewhere, perhaps linked with the man Jabez of 4:9-10. What the three clan names mean is not known.

decisions.choice: the Kenites and the house of Rechab
alternatives: came from the town of Hammath
decisions.reason: The Kenites were the people of Moses' father-in-law who settled with Judah (Judges 1:16). The house of Rechab includes Jehonadab son of Rechab (2 Kings 10:15) and the Rechabites of Jeremiah 35. Hammath may be the ancestor's name or a place.
Readable explains "father of" a family by "ancestor".
The usual Vietnamese word for scribes, people skilled in writing; the meaning decision notes it may be a clan name.
